# Extraction form

Ontology version 1, sha256 `23c7643ec1bf821e992363155445c560d7bc432a0208139311adc555a200adad`. Schemas: `form.json` (one record, JSON Schema 2020-12, additionalProperties false), `form_pass0.json` (one paper's named things). Per-type rules are if/then on `type` in the schema.

Out of scope (P133): a statement-only setting or observation (no quantity, value or qualifiers; only method or mentions) is not a form record.

Provider schema (P133, extract/common.py): an enum longer than 50 values is sent as a plain string, its ids listed in the prompt; form.json keeps the enum and the compiler validates against it (P134).

Pass-1 groups (P133b, extract/pass1_elements.py): one per section (abstract, s<n>); an element with no section mapping goes to its container: one group per figure (caption + panels), per table (caption + cells), per equation.
